transport.title: Getting there
transport.text: Metro line 8, Nuevos Ministerios — Aeropuerto T4, runs from 06:05 to 02:00 daily, including holidays. There are two stations at the airport: Aeropuerto T1-T2-T3 in Terminal 2 on Level 1 and Aeropuerto T4 in terminal T4 on Level −1. A single zone A ticket costs €1.50 to €2 depending on the number of stations, plus a €3 airport supplement.

taxi.title: Taxi
taxi.text: Taxi ranks are by the arrivals areas of terminals T1, T2 and T4 on Level 0; take a car only from a rank. Rate 4 is a flat €33 round the clock for trips from or to the airport starting or ending inside the M-30 ring road, with no surcharges. Rate 3 (the minimum for trips from the airport): starting price €22, minimum distance 9 km, €1.40 per kilometre, €27.00 per hour.

wifi.title: Wi‑Fi
wifi.text: Airport Free Wifi Aena network: log in on the start page with your email address as a guest or with an Aena Club account. You get 15 minutes of free internet to confirm your email; once it is confirmed, access has no time limit.
